note: GURA (2019, BiGRU + self-attention on GloVe vectors, Keras) is kept here as history, not as a competitor. Its numbers are validation accuracy at the best epoch, on validation sets that mixed in the test split, after re-training until a target was hit, so they are optimistic and not comparable with the held-out test scores above. The 2019 claim comes from a commit message; the 2023 values are read off the training charts in GURA's README (about one point of reading error). The MyAnimeList column used the summarised `myanimelist-sts` text, not the full reviews.
